$description: Scene material parameters (MI-layer) for the Unreal bridge pack — wave-XIV W2 → V0. Scalars mirror the canonical start-scene MI contract (docs/product/unreal-start-scenes-contract.md): gold recipe = MI_Alice_GoldWire/GoldTrim (Metal 1.0, Rough 0.22, EmissiveStrength 0.4); translucent recipe = MI_Alice_Organza (Opacity 0.32+, Rough 0.6). One value, one source — UE reads resolved numbers, never hand literals.

color.$comment: Base tint of the scene glass — same obsidian.800 that glassPanel.bg mixes at 55%.

opacity.$comment: glassPanel.bg = obsidian.800 @55% — the MI Opacity param is that same alpha, kept as a scalar because UE takes color and opacity separately.

emissive.$comment: Glass wash tint (ivory 6%, alpha-carrying) — translucent blend; emissive accent comes from the theme glow instead.

fresnel.$comment: Rim on glass edges reuses the scene fresnel scalar — one knob for all silhouette light.

color.$comment: Champagne gold base — nexus/alice accent primitive (#C9A45C).

roughness.$comment: MI_Alice_GoldWire canon (Rough 0.22; trim variant 0.3 lives in the scene-asset layer).

emissive.$comment: Per-theme emissive tint — nexus/alice gold, mech blue, forge amber, codex gold, arch violet.

emissiveStrength.$comment: MI_Alice_GoldWire canon (0.4 mid of the 0.2–0.6 window).

fresnel.$comment: Gold rim comes from metal specular, not a fresnel term — 0 is the authored value, not a default.
